name: Northside Baltimore [ALPHA]
description:
Your crew is waiting outside the corner store. In Northside Baltimore, you can roleplay a gang member, run with friends from your block and deal with what happens when a robbery brings the police to your door. If somebody gets booked, who’s putting up bail?

Make a resident, pick a haircut and take the car from the rowhouses to the Inner Harbor. Work a shift at the barbershop, answer a call as a paramedic, or put on a badge and patrol the same streets. When the shift ends, invite the block over for a house party.

Northside Baltimore is in Alpha. Open GUIDE for controls and directions.
